title: Native Git Hooks — Husky-parity experience for any repo
scope: Extend [git_hooks.native] (PRD-048) from inline-TOML hook bodies to the full Husky experience for non-Node repos: file-based hooks in a committed .jarvy/hooks/ dir, core.hooksPath install mode (zero-drift), `jarvy hooks add <stage> <cmd>` authoring, JARVY_SKIP_HOOKS bypass guard, minimal {staged_files} variable, and a hardened remote-config refusal matrix for hooks-path redirection. Full PRD: tasks/prd-059-native-hooks-husky-parity.md
follow_up: Phase 1: .jarvy/hooks/ dir + copy mode + `jarvy hooks add` + skip guard + docs (Path 4 in replace-husky.md)
Phase 2: hooks-path mode + uninstall + refusal matrix + {staged_files} + telemetry + Windows CI proof
Open: toml_edit for comment-preserving jarvy.toml writes from `hooks add`
